field.placeholder: JSON schema for the parameters of the action (leave empty if no arguments are needed)

page.div:
Available Context:
navigation: React Navigation instance (NavigationProp) - navigate, push, goBack, etc.
StackActions: React Navigation StackActions - push, pop, replace, etc.
Alert: React Native Alert API
Linking: React Native Linking API - openURL, canOpenURL, etc.
params: Tool parameters (userId, bundleId, record, arguments from AI)
env: Global environment (app context)
services: RPC, ORM services
JSON: JSON object (parse, stringify)
Math: Math object
Date: Date constructor
console: Console object (log, warn, error)
Forbidden: eval(), Function(), __proto__, constructor[], document.*, window.*, global.*, require(), import, .prototype, setTimeout, setInterval, XMLHttpRequest, fetch() (use services.rpc instead)
Error Handling: If JS execution fails on mobile, user will see AI text response only (fallback mode)
Bundle ID Restriction: Supports exact match (com.xboss.project.app) and wildcard (com.xboss.*)
